criteria.text: After I confirm cancel or replace when the run tab is closed or Herdr is down, a complete machine inspection finding no live process inside its worktree lets the request proceed.
A successful cancellation keeps all old work and PRs, saves cancelled state before releasing its claim, and replacement then starts a distinct run with its own worktree and branch.

Any live process inside the worktree makes cancel and replace refuse with its PID, observed command, how to stop it and the exact retry command, while the saved run and claim stay and no replacement starts.
An incomplete machine inspection makes cancel and replace refuse with the actual cause and recovery advice, without saving cancelled state, releasing the claim or starting a replacement.

The fallback counts an ordinary command, detached writer, idle shell, calling process and another user's process inside the worktree; it neither exempts them nor stops them automatically, and a sibling directory is outside.

An unconfirmed failed start without a saved pane can be cancelled or replaced after a complete native inspection proves the worktree has no live process; an old PID or an unreadable or changed identity never proves absence.
